name: swarms
description: The Swarms protocol behind one mod, both halves of it. RUNTIME: api.swarms.world runs a task through any of sixteen multi-agent orchestration architectures — SequentialWorkflow, ConcurrentWorkflow, HierarchicalSwarm, MixtureOfAgents, MajorityVoting, GroupChat, DebateWithJudge, CouncilAsAJudge, LLMCouncil, HeavySwarm, RoundRobin, AgentRearrange, MultiAgentRouter, PlannerWorkerSwarm, BatchedGridWorkflow and auto — plus single agents, reasoning agents, parallel batches, an auto-builder that turns a task into a roster, and the public swarms.world marketplace of published agents and prompts. TOKEN: the $swarms SPL token on Solana (mint 74SBV4zDXxTRgv1pEMoECskKBkZHc2yGPnc7GYVepump) — price, on-chain supply, holder concentration, wallet balances and Jupiter swap quotes. Eighteen MCP tools serve the same code the REST API and the browser console do, so an agent, a shell and a human never see different answers. BYOK for the runtime: every completion spends the caller's own Swarms credits. The chain half is read-only and holds no keypair — it can price a swap and cannot sign one.
backend: python stdlib only (http.server + urllib) — no dependencies

solana.launched: 2024-12-17 on pump.fun; trades mainly on Raydium

sources.chain: Solana JSON-RPC — supply, largest accounts, wallet balances
sources.price: jup.ag — aggregated USD price and swap routing

solana.signing: none — this module holds no keypair, builds no transaction and cannot submit one. `quote` prices a swap and returns the route; a person with a wallet executes it elsewhere.

endpoints.architectures: GET /architectures?refresh= — the sixteen swarm types, what each is for
endpoints.models: GET /models?q=&refresh= — models the runtime accepts as model_name
endpoints.tools: GET /tools — hosted tools an agent can be given by name
endpoints.run: POST /run {task, agents, swarm_type, max_loops, rearrange_flow, heavy_swarm_variant, …}
endpoints.agent: POST /agent {task, model_name, system_prompt, temperature, max_tokens, mcp_url, …}
endpoints.build: POST /build {task} — task in, agent roster out
endpoints.chat: POST /chat {model, messages|prompt, system} — the OpenAI-shaped shim
endpoints.cost: GET /cost?agents=&loops=&input_tokens=&output_tokens= — an upper bound, before the run
endpoints.account: GET /account — key state, credits, rate limits, live pricing
endpoints.token: GET /token?mint= — identity, supply, price, venues, FDV
endpoints.price: GET /price?mint=&limit= — spot price + every pool by liquidity
endpoints.balance: GET /balance?owner=&mint= — SOL, $swarms, and what it is worth
endpoints.quote: GET /quote?side=buy|sell&amount=&pay_with=SOL|USDC&slippage_bps= — a quote, never a trade
endpoints.state: GET /state — which key this request resolved to, the guard, the chain config
endpoints.raw: POST /raw {path, method, body, params, market} — any upstream route

byok.rule: every completion spends the caller's own Swarms credits — this module holds no house key
byok.chain: the Solana routes need no key and accept none

guard.what: a run whose upper-bound estimate exceeds SWARMS_SPEND_USD returns needs_confirm instead of running
guard.why: billing is per agent AND per token, so one mis-read swarm_type turns one task into fifty agent calls
guard.override: call again with confirm=true, or raise SWARMS_SPEND_USD

env.SWARMS_API_KEY: Swarms API key, checked before the keystore
env.SWARMS_SPEND_USD: spend guard: an estimated run above this needs confirm=true (default 0.50)
env.SWARMS_TIMEOUT: seconds to wait on a completion (default 300 — swarms are slow)
env.SWARMS_CACHE_TTL: seconds the model/architecture/marketplace catalogs are cached (default 600)
env.SWARMS_PUBLIC_URL: base URL used in mcp_config output
env.SWARMS_MINT: SPL mint the chain routes default to (default the $swarms mint)
env.SOLANA_RPC: Solana JSON-RPC endpoint (default api.mainnet-beta.solana.com, which rate-limits getTokenLargestAccounts)
env.SWARMS_CHAIN_TIMEOUT: seconds to wait on a chain read (default 30)
env.SWARMS_CHAIN_CACHE_TTL: seconds price and pool reads are cached (default 30)
